title: Can't get it work for RTX 50xx.
body:
Hi,

My setting env. is python 12.9, torch 2.8, cuda 128,  RTX 5070 Ti

I installed nunchaku-0.2.0+torch2.8-cp312-cp312-win_amd64 and the node is installed successfully, but got errors when loading node Nunchaku FLUX DiT loader:

got prompt
Using pytorch attention in VAE
Using pytorch attention in VAE
VAE load device: cuda:0, offload device: cpu, dtype: torch.bfloat16
GPU 0 (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti) Memory: 16302.5625 MiB
VRAM > 14GiB，disable CPU offload
[2025-04-06 16:31:44.683] [info] Initializing QuantizedFluxModel on device 0
[2025-04-06 16:31:44.974] [info] Loading weights from C:\Users\joezy\ComfyUI\models\diffusion_models\svdq-int4-flux.1-schnell\transformer_blocks.safetensors
Assertion failed: this->shape.dataExtent == other.shape.dataExtent, file C:\Users\muyang\Desktop\nunchaku-dev\src\Tensor.h, line 372

Any clues?
author: zytw

comments.body: Blackwell and Hopper does not native support int4, you need to use svdquant fp4 models.
Exactly, please use our FP4 models instead, which should have better quality.
Yes, FP4 works. Thank you so much.
